To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The neutron total cross section of gold is in good agreement with the ENDF/B-VII.1 evaluation and (2) the total cross section of tantalum shows a significant difference from the ENDF/B- VII.1 evaluation.

the neutron total cross section of 197Au is in good agreement with previous measurements and the ENDF/B-VII.1 evaluation, while the total cross section of natTa is in good agreement only with the evaluation of ENDF/B-VIII.0 and is lower than previous measurements and ENDF/B-VI.8 and ENDF/B- VII.1.
(i) The measured neutron total cross sections agree with the data of the National Nuclear Data Center (NNDC) in most cases within the uncertainties of both data sets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
neutron scattering experiments at the nELBe facility at the HZB in Berlin.
the measurement and analysis of nuclear reaction cross sections, in particular for the study of nuclear reactions with fast neutrons and gamma rays.
the investigation of neutron total cross section measurements with high energy resolution, low neutron flux and short flight paths.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present data are in good agreement with the data of ENDF/B-VII.1 and JEFF-3.1.2, but the present data are systematically higher than the data of JENDL-4.0.
the present results agree with the evaluated data within 1% for 197Au and within 1–2% for natTa.
the present measurements are in very good agreement with the evaluated data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the measurements of the total cross section are in good agreement with previous data, and that the present work is the most complete set of measurements for 197Au and the first measurements for natTa at nELBE.
the measurements are consistent with the existing data sets and that the data are of comparable quality.
the measurements at nELBE are very competitive to other measurements and that the data can be used as a benchmark for nuclear data libraries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the neutron total cross section of gold and tantalium can be measured with high precision at the nELBe photoneutron source.
the total cross sections of gold and tantalums are well described by ENDF/B-VII.1 and JEFF-3.1.2.
the neutron total cross section measurements are possible with a high accuracy even at the lowest neutron fluxes of 104/sr/s.
